description: Domestic Airlines - Top Routes and Totals is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. Covers Regular Public Transport (RPT) air services between Australian airports. Data is by city pair and month for passengers carried, aircraft trips, great circle distance between two airports (connected to city), Revenue Passenger Kilometres (RPKs), Available Seat Kilometres (ASKs) and Seats. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics. Its tags are ASK, RPK, aircraft, airlines, australian aviation statistics. It offers 5 resource(s) in csv, txt. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
